$comment: SYNCED FROM AI-Handbook — do not edit in a consumer repo. Local edits are overwritten by the next sync and their reasoning is lost; change the handbook instead.

recommendation.description: One line: what, if anything, David should do. "Nothing needed from you" is a real answer. Do not justify it -- he assumes you checked, and a paragraph saying so was cut for being useless (David, 2026-09-19).

about.description: One sentence: what this round was about. It leads the report, so it is the reader's orientation, not a summary of your work.

disagreements.description: Where your reading differs from the builder's account. An empty array is a real answer. This is the section David values most per word, so when trimming for length, trim everything else first.

why_it_matters.description: What it means for David if you are right.

findings.description: One entry per finding the reviewer raised this round, in the reviewer's order. Empty when the round raised none.

raised.description: What could have gone wrong, one clause, outcome not mechanism.

done.description: What the builder did about it, one clause; its size when that is the point.

holds.description: Fix: the diff does what the reply claims. Decline: its reasoning stands. null when unanswered.

overbuilt.description: true when the builder wrote more than the finding was worth.

took_on_trust.description: What you saw and accepted without checking. Almost never empty. NOT shown to David -- it is read by a later round's translator as the list worth rechecking, so write it for that reader.

could_not_assess.description: One sentence when something was beyond your reach; null when nothing was.

model.description: The model id you are actually running as. null, never prose, when you cannot determine it.

builder_answered.description: Whether the builder (the pull request's author) had replied to this round's findings when you read them.

known_gaps.description: FINAL ROUND ONLY. What is shipping unfixed. Empty means nothing is.

what.description: What could happen, not what the code does.

why.description: Why; plainly, when you disagree with the decline.

what_landed.description: FINAL ROUND ONLY. The description's stated intent held against what the diff does.

does_not_do.description: What it does not do that David might assume it does.

now_trusting.description: What David is now trusting that he was not before.
